name: Field Repair
description: +10% durability to one item at a rest room for one material unit. +1% per rank; rank 10: no material needed once per floor. Warden, Blade and Beast Tamer +2 at start; the Dwarf's Forge-born adds 2.

mastery.text: Rank 10 is the line in the description; the per-rank numbers live in tuning.json (skills.fieldSkills).
